Operational Bottleneck Identified:
The warehouse uses an outdated First-In-First-Out (FIFO) storage system. This creates a bottleneck because newer stock is placed behind older items, making it difficult and time-consuming to access recent inventory for shipments. The process requires significant manual reorganization efforts every time newer items are needed, reducing overall efficiency.

Efficiency Improvement Suggestion:
Implement a dynamic storage system or a warehouse management system (WMS) that allows for flexible slotting. Instead of strictly stacking new items behind old ones, use a system that directs pickers to the most accessible location for any given item, regardless of arrival time, or use a "last-in-first-out" (LIFO) approach for specific fast-moving items to reduce handling time. Alternatively, introduce cross-docking for high-turnover items to bypass storage entirely.
